items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: There was one old time musician Papa Lane, he said he was playing especially in Gretna

ctx.x: But, they're the first one I saw. I might have seen Papa Lane's band there.

There was one old time musician Papa Lane, he said he was playing especially in Gretna, I think the David Crockett Fire department. Yeah, yeah, yeah. I think they'd even buried with music and one of their members had done. Yeah, yeah. Well, they had the, they had the. Some of those clubs and stuff like that.

Yeah. Then they had a, well, I forget his name. He lived down here on Alex Street. I forget his name. They had a brass band too. Street band, you know. He's dead too now. I forget his name now. But, they're the first one I saw playing like that. Finally after I saw, you know, color.
